title: Root MUST send DAO-ACK for every DAO received — unmet in all three stacks (draft 7.3, R-RPL-026)
description:
Spec: draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 7.3 — 'Root MUST send DAO-ACK for every DAO received'. Appendix-rpl sweep R-RPL-026, divergent, confidence high.
Evidence: Rust root path emits no DAO-ACK at all — RplNode::handle_dao (rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs:394-453) returns an outcome without TX, and lichen-gateway/src/tdma_fsm.rs:35,51-52 awaits TdmaEvent::DaoAckWithSlot which nothing emits. C: K-flag-gated only (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_process.c:989-995 — ACK iff result != REJECTED && K flag set), and C's own DAO builder sends ack_requested=false (rpl_dao_build.c:250), so C-to-C DAOs are never ACKed; live gateway root uses the non-ACK variant (lichen/apps/gateway/src/rpl_root.c:275-281). Python: same K gate (dao_manager.py:714; builders default ack_requested=False). Codec/vectors exist everywhere (rpl_messages.json dao_ack corpus; Rust message.rs:1642-1770). C comment rpl_dao_process.c:256-261 cites draft '7.3,7.5' as the narrower ack_requested-only contract.
Suggested placement: first adjudicate the contract (unconditional per current draft text vs K-flag-gated per C code comment — flagged F6b for Opus), then implement + test in all three stacks. Affects bidirectional-verification dependency (R-RPL-006/016 bead) and short-address assignment.
